movelist.name: Feather Dance
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Attack lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Baton Pass
movelist.effect: The user is replaced with another Pokémon from their trainer’s roster. All Combat Stage, Coats, and [Stratagems] on Baton Pass’ user are transferred to the replacement. Baton Pass may be used to switch even if the user is Trapped.

movelist.name: Air Cutter
movelist.effect: Air Cutter is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Helping Hand
movelist.effect: Helping Hand grants the target +2 on their next Accuracy Roll this round, and +10 to the next Damage Roll this round.

abilities.name: Dancer
abilities.trigger: Someone within 10 meters uses a StatusClass Dance Move
abilities.effect: The user may immediately use the triggering Move as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Spinning Dance
abilities.trigger: The user is targeted by an attack, but is missed
abilities.effect: If not Fainted, Paralyzed, or Asleep, the user gains +1 Evasion and may immediately Shift 1 meter.
